name: Q3 Fire Safety Drill
description: Quarterly fire-safety drill compliance check across primary and secondary blocks. Confirms evacuation routes, mustering points, and the wing-wise headcount procedure.

name: Cafeteria Hygiene Review
description: Monthly food-handling and cafeteria hygiene assessment covering staff hand-wash compliance, ingredient storage temperatures, and allergen-labeling adherence.

name: Transport Pre-Trip Audit
description: Pre-trip transport-safety audit for the inter-school tournament. Confirms vehicle condition, driver license validity, first-aid kit completeness, and emergency contacts.
